socfpga_ddr_mailbox.c

Sends IOSSM mailbox commands and reads calibration, memory size, ECC, and memory-init status.

wait_for_bit
static inline int wait_for_bit(
const 
void 
*
reg,
const 
uint32_t 
mask,
const 
bool 
set,
const unsigned 
int 
timeout_ms
)

Polls a 32-bit register until the masked bits match, or time runs out.

The wait is timeout_ms / 1000 whole seconds, with one second between reads. When set is true, every bit in mask must be 1. When set is false, every bit in mask must be 0.

Parameters
reg
const void*

Address of the register to read.

mask
const uint32_t

Bits to test.

set
const bool

true waits for the bits to be set. false waits for them to be clear.

timeout_ms
const unsigned int

Limit in milliseconds. Divided by 1000 before use.

Returns

0 when the bits match.  -ETIMEDOUT when the seconds run out.

is_double_bit_error
static bool is_double_bit_error(
enum 
ecc_error_type 
err_type
)

Returns true for the double-bit ECC error types.  Those types are DOUBLE_BIT_ERROR, MULTIPLE_DOUBLE_BIT_ERRORS, WRITE_LINK_DOUBLE_BIT_ERROR, READ_LINK_DOUBLE_BIT_ERROR, and READ_MODIFY_WRITE_DOUBLE_BIT_ERROR.

Parameters
err_type
enum ecc_error_type

Value from the ECC error type field.

Returns

true for the five types above, otherwise false.

out_of_band_ecc_bist_mem_init
static int out_of_band_ecc_bist_mem_init(
struct 
io96b_info 
*
io96b_ctrl
)

Runs memory-init BIST for out-of-band ECC.

Sends BIST_MEM_INIT_START with the first parameter set to 0x40.  The low bit of the short response must be set, or this returns -ENOEXEC. Then polls bit 0 of the memory init status every 500 ms.  The poll count is TIMEOUT / 500.

Parameters
io96b_ctrl
struct io96b_info*

Interfaces to initialize.

Returns

0 when every interface reports init done.  -ENOEXEC if BIST does not start.  -ETIMEDOUT if the status bit stays clear.

inline_ecc_bist_mem_init
static int inline_ecc_bist_mem_init(
struct 
io96b_info 
*
io96b_ctrl
)

Runs memory-init BIST for inline ECC.

Each interface size must be a non-zero power of two. The command stores log2 of that size in the BIST address-space field and uses start address 0. Polls bit 0 of the init status the same way as the out-of-band path.

Parameters
io96b_ctrl
struct io96b_info*

Interfaces to initialize. memory_size must already be set.

Returns

0 when every interface reports init done.  -ENOEXEC if a size is not a power of two, or BIST does not start.  -ETIMEDOUT if the status bit stays clear.
